verdict.rationale: Linear's Loops are first-party recurring agent workflows. Users describe the job in plain language and choose whether it runs on a schedule or in response to an event, and loops now also react to initiative, project, and cycle changes, for example updating launch plans and posting to Slack. The evidence is changelog-level only. Missing for 10: documented schedule configuration (frequency/cron granularity, time zones), run history and monitoring or failure handling for scheduled jobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
